== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Darth Vader, Betrayer Of The Jedi (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 2)]] (<code>1261_10</code>), showing the '''PC-E2''' game text. No full card image shows this text: the Virtual Block 6 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-10-Darth_Vader_Betrayer_Of_The_Jedi.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-darthvaderbetrayerofthejedi-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Darth Vader, Betrayer Of The Jedi (Virtual Block 6)]]; the Master List prints this text on its slip (Dark Side, p. 7).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side, p. 7; cover “official text as of April 27, 2013”), [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive copy] ([[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf]]).
* '''PC-E2 text:''' “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. The Circle Is Now Complete is canceled. While present with [Reflections 3] Obi-Wan or a Jedi Council Member, may add one battle destiny, lightsabers here may not be 'swung' twice, and their immunity to attrition is canceled. Immune to attrition < 5.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number, copyright line) with this game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-10-Darth_Vader_Betrayer_Of_The_Jedi-PC-E2-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B09 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
